title: 加息概率跳升：市场为何不慌？，盈利撑腰
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yeah, I think Porsche delivered on what the market participants wanted.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为保时捷满足了市场参与者的期望。

segments.en: Number one, he gave some view of the economy, which I think was important.
segments.zh: 首先，他对经济给出了一些看法，我认为这很重要。

segments.en: He indicated that it was strong, it was resilient. That's how we all feel.
segments.zh: 他表示经济强劲且有韧性，这也是我们的共同感受。

segments.en: I love that he talked about profits because that's incredibly important for us as investors.
segments.zh: 我喜欢他谈到利润，因为这对我们市场参与者来说极其重要。

segments.en: I love his commitment once again to the 2% inflation target, reiterating that that's something that Fed is laser focused on and not backing away from.
segments.zh: 我也欣赏他再次承诺2%的通胀目标，重申美联储对此高度关注，不会退缩。

segments.en: And I think that you know you're seeing this sort of stability in the equity markets, because we got what we needed from this speech.
segments.zh: 我认为权益市场之所以稳定，是因为我们从这次讲话中得到了所需的信息。

segments.en: Stability in equity markets, even if there is a hike. I mean, this is sort of the interesting note.
segments.zh: 即使加息，权益市场也能保持稳定，这是值得注意的一点。

segments.en: You are seeing the expectation for a Fed funds rate hike for the September meeting, go from before the hike at something like 35 percent or before the speech to something
segments.zh: 我们看到市场对九月会议加息的预期，从讲话前的约35%上升到了现在的约50%。

segments.en: like 35 percent. Now we're up to about 50 percent. Yeah, is this acceptable right now?
segments.zh: 现在大约50%。这目前可以接受吗？

segments.en: That's not necessarily going to take the froth out of equity markets.
segments.zh: 这未必会消除权益市场的泡沫。

segments.en: Look, I think we should all expect September is a live meeting.
segments.zh: 我认为我们都应预期九月会议会有动作。

segments.en: We like the kind of 50-50 probabilities at this point because we don't exactly know how the data will come in, especially the CPI print that will come in in a couple weeks.
segments.zh: 目前我们倾向于五五开的概率，因为尚不确定数据表现，尤其是几周后公布的CPI。

segments.en: I don't think the equity market is as sensitive to higher rates as the economy is.
segments.zh: 我认为权益市场对利率上升的敏感度不如经济。

segments.en: And I think that's the key driver here. Look at this quarter after quarter of double-digit blockbuster earnings growth.
segments.zh: 这是关键驱动因素。看这连续几个季度两位数的强劲盈利增长。

segments.en: Right. Incredibly high revenue, raising guidance. I mean, that kind of momentum is not going to be derailed by a couple 25 basis point hikes in
segments.zh: 没错，收入极高，上调指引。这种势头不会因几次加息而受挫。

segments.en: the market. That's right where I wanted to go.
